Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Shri Ishwar Chandra Tyagi, learned counsel for the applicant and Shri Ravi Kant Kushwaha, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No.444 of 2023, under Sections 409, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC, Police Station Kotwali, District Maharajganj, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged on 06.08.2023 against as many as 114 persons including applicant, who is lady and according to the FIR, applicant with the help of the farmers, who purchased tractors from her firm, misappropriated the amount of subsidy granted by the Government to the farmers alongwith the farmers.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation made in the F.I.R. against Smt. Isaravati Devi vs State Of U.P.And Another on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188293738/

sentences.text:
1 applicant is totally false and baseless and subsidy was released by the Government for agricultural equipments to those farmers, who purchased tractors and applicant only deals in tractors and not in the agricultural equipments and during enquiry this fact has been disclosed by her through affidavit.
5.

He further submits that when applicant came to know that on the basis of forged bill and voucher of her firm huge amount of subsidy has been misappropriated then on 25.03.2023, she herself made a complaint on the Government Portal, which has been annexed as Annexure No.2 to the affidavit filed in support of the instant anticipatory bail application.
6. He further submits that after five months, FIR of the present case was lodged in which applicant was also made accused.

7. He further submits that on the basis of false allegation, merely under presumption, applicant has been made accused in the present matter and she never participated in the alleged fraud and misappropriation.

8. He further submits that applicant is a lady and is not having any previous criminal history to her credit and police is continuously trying to make her arrest and therefore, she may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
9.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but could not dispute the fact that FIR of the present case was lodged on 06.08.2023 but even much earlier on 25.03.2023 applicant made a complaint on the Government Portal stating therein that some persons by making forged bill and voucher of her firm did the forgery.
He further could not dispute the fact that applicant is a lady and is not having any previous criminal history to her credit.
10. I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. However, as per allegation applicant and other accused persons by playing fraud misappropriated the subsidy amount on the basis of forged documents but from the record, it reflects that applicant is proprietor of Rahul Tractors and her firm engaged in selling of the tractors and she does not run a business for purchasing and selling of agricultural equipments and alleged subsidy was released by the Government for the agricultural equipments and as per applicant, she never issued any bill and voucher with regard to the agricultural equipments and all the bills and vouchers submitted by the other accused persons, who were farmers, were forged one and applicant cannot be held liable for that.

12. Further, from Annexure No.2 of the affidavit, it appears that even before lodgement of the FIR of the present case in the month of March, 2023, applicant has made a complaint on the Government Portal stating entire facts.
13. Further, applicant is a lady and is not having any previous criminal history to her credit.

In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

18. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
